items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Eddie, this is Helen, and we are going to go back and do some of that material we did earlier...

ctx.x: Eddie, this is Helen, and we are going to go back and do some of that material we did earlier which turned out to be abortive because of the tape. So now we have to hope that everything's going well and we can remember all those interesting things we were talking about.
I do remember what we started out with. We started out talking about your mother being a schoolteacher.
